words.gloss: for the welfare of the world

hindi: जिन्होंने गणना योग्य (विषयों) की गणना कर ली थी, ऐसे सांख्यों के साथ बैठे हुए पुनर्वसु से वह्निवेश ने जगत् के हित के लिए अपना संशय पूछा।
english: Vahniveśa asked Punarvasu, who was seated with the Sāṃkhyas who had enumerated what is to be enumerated, about his own doubt, for the welfare of the world.
notes: sāṃkhya may mean followers of the Sāṃkhya system or, more generally, men skilled in enumeration/reasoning. vahni and agni are synonyms ('fire'). papraccha takes two accusatives (the person asked, the thing asked).

hindi: स्नेह किन योनियों वाले हैं, कितने हैं, और स्नेहों के गुण अलग-अलग क्या हैं? किसका काल और अनुपान क्या है, और विचारणाएँ कितनी और कौन-सी हैं?
english: Of what sources are the unctuous substances (sneha), how many are they, and what are the qualities of the snehas separately? What are the time and the after-drink (anupāna) of which (sneha), and how many and which are the variant modes of use (vicāraṇā)?
notes: Units 4 to 8 are Vahniveśa's list of questions. vicāraṇā is used in this chapter for sneha given combined with other foods or preparations (see units 23 to 26).
lines_deva: किंयोनयः कति स्नेहाः के च स्नेहगुणाः पृथक्
कालानुपाने के कस्य कति काश्च विचारणाः
lines_iast: kiṃyonayaḥ kati snehāḥ ke ca snehaguṇāḥ pṛthak
kālānupāne ke kasya kati kāśca vicāraṇāḥ

hindi: मात्राएँ कितनी हैं, किस मान की हैं, और कौन-सी (मात्रा) किनके लिए बताई जाती है? कौन-सा स्नेह किनके लिए हितकर है, और स्नेहन में परम सीमा क्या है?
english: How many are the measures (mātrā), of what amount are they, and which is prescribed for whom? Which sneha is beneficial for whom, and what is the utmost limit in oleation (snehana)?
notes: prakarṣa 'utmost limit, maximum'; the line does not say whether a limit of time or of degree is meant.
lines_deva: कति मात्राः कथंमानाः का च केषूपदिश्यते
कश्च केभ्यो हितः स्नेहः प्रकर्षः स्नेहने च कः
lines_iast: kati mātrāḥ kathaṃmānāḥ kā ca keṣūpadiśyate
kaśca kebhyo hitaḥ snehaḥ prakarṣaḥ snehane ca kaḥ

words.gloss: signs of the properly oleated, the unoleated and the over-oleated

hindi: किन्हें स्नेहन कराना चाहिए और किन्हें नहीं, तथा सम्यक् स्निग्ध, अस्निग्ध और अतिस्निग्ध के लक्षण क्या हैं? पीने से पहले, पी लेने पर और पच जाने पर क्या हितकर और क्या अहितकर है?
english: Who are to be oleated and who are not, and what are the signs of the properly oleated, the unoleated and the over-oleated? What is wholesome and what unwholesome before drinking, when it has been drunk, and when it is digested?
notes: snigdha in the compound is taken as 'properly oleated' in contrast with asnigdha and atisnigdha.
lines_deva: स्नेह्याः के के न च स्निग्धास्निग्धातिस्निग्धलक्षणम्

words.gram: m. nom. pl., bahuvrīhi with dvandva

hindi: किनका कोष्ठ मृदु और किनका क्रूर होता है? व्यापत्तियाँ कौन-सी हैं और सिद्धियाँ कौन-सी? और अच्छ स्नेह तथा संशोधन स्नेह में कौन-सी वृत्ति अभीष्ट है?
english: Who have a soft and who a hard (krūra) bowel (koṣṭha)? What are the ill effects (vyāpad) and what are the successes (siddhi)? And what regimen is prescribed in the case of plain sneha and of purifying sneha?
notes: kā before vyāpadaḥ stands for kāḥ (visarga lost before a voiced sound). siddhi here may mean the successful management of the ill effects just named. acche and saṃśodhane may both qualify snehe (plain sneha; purifying sneha) or saṃśodhane may be a noun ('in purification').
lines_deva: के मृदुक्रूरकोष्ठाः का व्यापदः सिद्धयश्च काः
अच्छे संशोधने चैव स्नेहे का वृत्तिरिष्यते
lines_iast: ke mṛdukrūrakoṣṭhāḥ kā vyāpadaḥ siddhayaśca kāḥ
acche saṃśodhane caiva snehe kā vṛttiriṣyate

hindi: विचारणाएँ किनमें और किस विधि से प्रयोग की जानी चाहिए? हे प्रभो, हे अपरिमित ज्ञान वाले, मैं स्नेह का वह ज्ञान जानना चाहता हूँ।
english: For whom are the vicāraṇās to be applied, and by which procedure? O lord, you of boundless knowledge, I wish to know that knowledge of sneha.
notes: The '!' after prabho is a punctuation mark of the typed text. tat is taken with jñānam ('that knowledge'); it may also be read as 'that (all)' summing up the questions. snehasya may also be taken with amitavijñāna ('O you of boundless knowledge of sneha').
lines_deva: विचारणाः केषु योज्या विधिना केन तत् प्रभो!

english: Then Punarvasu, the cutter of his doubt, replied: The source of the snehas, O gentle one, is twofold: immobile and mobile.

english: Tila, priyāla and abhiṣuka, bibhītaka, citrā, abhayā, eraṇḍa, madhūka, sarṣapa, kusumbha, bilva, āruka, mūlaka, atasī, nikocaka, akṣoḍa, karañja and śigruka,
notes: The sentence continues into unit 11 (these are the 'repositories of sneha termed immobile'). Metre: each printed line is two 12-syllable pādas (vaṃśastha/indravaṃśa type). In the long compound, abhayā + eraṇḍa gives abhayairaṇḍa. Identifications: tila = Sesamum indicum (standard); priyāla = Buchanania lanzan (standard); abhiṣuka = Pistacia vera (disputed); bibhītaka = Terminalia bellirica (standard); citrā = unidentified (disputed); abhayā = Terminalia chebula (standard); eraṇḍa = Ricinus communis, castor (standard); madhūka = Madhuca longifolia (standard); sarṣapa = Brassica species, mustard (standard); kusumbha = Carthamus tinctorius, safflower (standard); bilva = Aegle marmelos (standard); āruka = Prunus persica (probable); mūlaka = Raphanus sativus, radish (standard); atasī = Linum usitatissimum, linseed (standard); nikocaka = unidentified (disputed); akṣoḍa = Juglans regia, walnut (standard); karañja = Pongamia pinnata (standard); śigruka (śigru) = Moringa oleifera (standard).

hindi: ये स्थावर नाम वाले स्नेह के आशय हैं; इसी प्रकार जङ्गम (आशय) मछलियाँ और पक्षियों सहित मृग होंगे। उनके दही, दूध, घी, मांस, वसा और मज्जा इसी प्रकार स्नेहों में बताए जाते हैं।
english: these are the repositories of sneha termed immobile. Likewise the mobile ones would be fish and animals (mṛga), together with birds; of them, curd, milk, ghee, flesh, muscle-fat and marrow are likewise taught among the snehas.
notes: The subject of line a is the list of unit 10. upadiśyate is singular, agreeing with the nearest subject. mṛga may mean wild or game animals in particular. Metre as in unit 10.
lines_deva: तेषां दधिक्षीरघृतामिषं वसा स्नेहेषु मज्जा च तथोपदिश्यते

hindi: सभी तेलों के प्रकारों में तिल का तेल श्रेष्ठ है; बल के लिए स्नेहन में यह अग्रणी है, परन्तु विरेचन में एरण्ड का तेल। एरण्ड का तेल कटु, उष्ण, वात और श्लेष्मा को हरने वाला तथा गुरु है; कषाय, मधुर और तिक्त (द्रव्यों) से युक्त करने पर यह पित्त का भी नाश करता है।
english: Of all kinds of oil, tila oil excels; it is foremost in oleation for strength, but castor oil (airaṇḍa) in purgation. Castor oil is pungent, hot, removes Vāta and Kapha (śleṣman), and is heavy; combined with astringent, sweet and bitter (substances) it destroys Pitta also.
notes: Lines c and d are printed inside round brackets and end with '||)', in the typed edition; the input does not say what the brackets mean; they are kept as printed. agryam in line b is taken with tilatailam of line a. The '(' and '||)' are print marks attached to the tokens.

hindi: घी, तेल, वसा और मज्जा सब स्नेहों में उत्तम माने गए हैं; और इनमें घी उत्तम है, क्योंकि वह संस्कार का अनुवर्तन करता है।
english: Ghee, oil, muscle-fat and marrow are considered the best of all snehas; and among these ghee is the best, because it follows the processing (saṃskāra).
notes: saṃskārasya anuvartanāt is rendered literally ('because it follows the processing'); the line does not say in what way ghee follows it.

words.gram: n. nom. sg., tat-puruṣa with dvandva
n. nom. sg., tat-puruṣa with dvandva

hindi: घी पित्त और अनिल को हरने वाला, रस, शुक्र और ओज के लिए हितकर, निर्वापण करने वाला, मृदु करने वाला तथा स्वर और वर्ण को निर्मल करने वाला है।
english: Ghee removes Pitta and Vāta (anila), is beneficial for rasa, semen (śukra) and ojas (vital essence), is cooling, softening, and clarifies the voice and complexion.
notes: rasa here is the bodily rasa, named with śukra and ojas, not taste.

hindi: तेल मारुत का नाश करने वाला है और श्लेष्मा को नहीं बढ़ाता; वह बल बढ़ाने वाला, त्वचा के लिए हितकर, उष्ण, स्थिरता देने वाला और योनि का शोधन करने वाला है।
english: Oil destroys Vāta (māruta) and does not increase Kapha (śleṣman); it increases strength, is good for the skin, hot, gives firmness, and purifies the yoni (female genital passage).

words.gloss: in pierced wounds, fractures, blows, displaced yoni, and pain of ear and head

english: Muscle-fat (vasā) is prescribed for pierced wounds, fractures, blows, displaced yoni, and pain of ear and head, for increase of virility, in oleation and in exercise.
notes: The grouping inside the compound is ambiguous: bhraṣṭa may go with yoni ('displaced/prolapsed yoni', as translated) or stand alone ('dislocated'), and ruj may govern yoni as well as ear and head ('pain of yoni, ear and head').

english: Marrow increases strength, semen (śukra), rasa, Kapha (śleṣman), fat (medas) and marrow; it especially gives strength to the bones and is beneficial in oleation.
notes: majjā (majjan) is masculine, hence the masculine adjectives.
lines_deva: मज्जा विशेषतोऽस्थ्नां च बलकृत् स्नेहने हितः

hindi: घी शरद् में पीना चाहिए, वसा और मज्जा माधव में, और तेल प्रावृट् में; मनुष्य न अधिक उष्ण और न अधिक शीत (समय) में स्नेह पिए।
english: Ghee is to be drunk in Śarad, muscle-fat and marrow in Mādhava, oil in Prāvṛṭ; a man should drink sneha when it is neither excessively hot nor cold.
notes: Season and month names: Śarad = autumn; Mādhava = the month Vaiśākha (about April-May); Prāvṛṭ = the beginning of the rains (standard equivalents). na may be read with atyuṣṇaśīte ('in what is not excessively hot or cold', as translated) or with pibet ('should not drink in excessive heat or cold'); the sense is the same.
lines_deva: सर्पिः शरदि पातव्यं वसा मज्जा च माधवे

words.gloss: one with predominant Vāta and Pitta

hindi: वात और पित्त की अधिकता वाला मनुष्य रात्रि में और उष्ण (काल) में भी पिए; श्लेष्मा की अधिकता वाला दिन में, शीत (काल) में और सूर्य के निर्मल रहते पिए।
english: A man with predominant Vāta and Pitta should drink at night, and also in hot weather; one with predominant Kapha should drink by day, in cold weather, and when the sun is clear.
notes: The object (sneha) is understood from unit 18.

words.gloss: by one with predominant Vāta and Pitta

hindi: अत्यधिक उष्णता में अथवा दिन में, वात और पित्त की अधिकता वाले द्वारा पिया गया (स्नेह) मूर्च्छा, प्यास, उन्माद अथवा कामला उत्पन्न कर सकता है।
english: If drunk in excessive heat or by day by one with predominant Vāta and Pitta, it may bring about fainting, thirst, insanity (unmāda) or kāmalā.

text_flags.why: possible typo: 'va' is not a word in this sense; the parallel vā of the same line and the sense 'or' require vā (the metre allows either at the end of the pāda).

hindi: शीत (काल) में अथवा रात्रि में स्नेह पीने वाला श्लेष्मा की अधिकता वाला मनुष्य भी आनाह, अरुचि, शूल अथवा पाण्डुता को प्राप्त होता है।

hindi: गण्डूष, कर्णतैल, और नासा, कान तथा नेत्रों का तर्पण, इस प्रकार ये स्नेह की चौबीस प्रविचारणाएँ हैं।
english: gaṇḍūṣa (liquid held in the mouth), ear-oil, and tarpaṇa through the nose, ears and eyes: thus these are the twenty-four variant modes of use (pravicāraṇā) of sneha.
notes: Counting units 23 to 25 as odana, vilepī, rasa, māṃsa, payas, dadhi, yavāgū, sūpa, śāka, yūṣa, kāmbalika, khaḍa, saktu, tilapiṣṭa, madya, leha, bhakṣya, abhyañjana, basti, uttarabasti, gaṇḍūṣa, karṇataila, nasal tarpaṇa and eye tarpaṇa gives twenty-four; on that count karṇa inside the last compound repeats karṇataila. nastaḥ (adverb 'through the nose') stands as the first member of the compound.

hindi: परन्तु जो स्नेह अच्छ रूप में पीने योग्य है, उसे विचारणा नहीं कहते; वह वैद्यों द्वारा देखा गया स्नेह का प्राथमिक कल्प है।
english: But the sneha which is to be drunk plain (accha) they do not call a vicāraṇā; that, recognised by physicians, is the primary mode (kalpa) of sneha.
notes: tām is feminine by attraction to vicāraṇām. bhiṣagdṛṣṭa is literally 'seen by physicians'.

words.gram: m. inst. pl., tat-puruṣa with dvandva

hindi: समास और व्यास से जुड़े छह रसों के साथ मिलाया गया स्नेह तिरसठ प्रकार की संख्या को प्राप्त होता है, और एक केवल (स्नेह) है।
english: Sneha combined with the six tastes (rasa), joined collectively and singly, attains a number of sixty-three kinds, and one is plain.
notes: Sixty-three is the number of combinations of six tastes taken one, two, three and more at a time; with the one plain sneha this gives the sixty-four of unit 28. ca after rasaiḥ is taken as a connective.

words.gram: f. nom. sg., gerundive (kṛtya) pra-√yuj (with bhavet)

hindi: इस प्रकार स्नेहों की ये चौंसठ प्रविचारणाएँ हैं; जानकार को इन्हें ओक, ऋतु, व्याधि और पुरुष के अनुसार प्रयोग करना चाहिए।
english: Thus these are the sixty-four variant modes of use (pravicāraṇā) of the snehas; they should be applied by one who knows, with regard to habit (okas), season, disease and the person.
notes: pravicāraṇā is taken as nominative plural (pravicāraṇāḥ, the visarga lost before the vowel of the next half-verse), agreeing with etāḥ. The accusative okartuvyādhipuruṣān expresses 'with regard to'. The sixty-four here (63 combinations with tastes + 1 plain) are a different count from the twenty-four of unit 25. bhavet is singular, so prayojyā is f. nom. sg. agreeing with catuḥṣaṣṭiḥ; pravicāraṇā may likewise be read as printed, f. nom. sg., with etāḥ plural by sense.

words.gram: m. acc. sg. (duration), dvandva (samāhāra; masculine by rule)

hindi: प्रधान, मध्यम और ह्रस्व स्नेह-मात्रा पाचन के लिए क्रमशः एक अहोरात्र, पूरे दिन और आधे दिन तक प्रतीक्षा करती है।
english: The major, medium and small measure of sneha waits, for its digestion, a day and night, a whole day, and half a day respectively.
notes: The three durations are matched in order with the three measures. ahorātra is a samāhāra dvandva which grammar treats as masculine; kṛtsnam is taken with ahaḥ, though it may qualify ahorātram ('a whole day and night').
lines_deva: प्रधाना मध्यमा ह्रस्वा स्नेहमात्रा जरां प्रति
lines_iast: pradhānā madhyamā hrasvā snehamātrā jarāṃ prati

hindi: इस प्रकार मान के आधार पर स्नेह की तीन मात्राएँ बताई गईं; उनके प्रयोग मैं प्रत्येक पुरुष के अनुसार कहूँगा।
english: Thus three measures of sneha have been set out by quantity; I shall state their administration for each person.
notes: samuddiṣṭā stands for samuddiṣṭāḥ (visarga lost before m).
lines_deva: इति तिस्रः समुद्दिष्टा मात्राः स्नेहस्य मानतः
तासां प्रयोगान् वक्ष्यामि पुरुषं पुरुषं प्रति
lines_iast: iti tisraḥ samuddiṣṭā mātrāḥ snehasya mānataḥ
tāsāṃ prayogān vakṣyāmi puruṣaṃ puruṣaṃ prati

words.gram: m. nom. pl., upapada tat-puruṣa with dvandva

hindi: जो मनुष्य प्रचुर स्नेह के नित्य अभ्यस्त हैं, भूख और प्यास सहने वाले हैं, जिनकी अग्नि उत्तम बल वाली है, और जो बल में उत्तम हैं,
english: Men who are habituated to plentiful sneha, who endure hunger and thirst, whose digestive fire (pāvaka) is of the highest strength, and who are highest in strength,
notes: The sentence runs through units 31 to 33 (subject: these persons; verb pibeyuḥ in unit 33).

hindi: गुल्म के रोगी, सर्प से डसे हुए, और जो विसर्प से पीड़ित हैं, उन्मत्त, कष्ट से मूत्र त्यागने वाले और कठोर मल वाले,
english: those with gulma, those bitten by snakes, and those who are afflicted by visarpa, the insane, those with difficult urination, and those with hard stools,
notes: gāḍhavarcasa stands for gāḍhavarcasaḥ (visarga lost before e).

words.gram: f. nom. sg., ppp. caus. pra-√yuj

hindi: उत्तम मात्रा पिएँ। उसके पीने के गुण सुनो: सम्यक् प्रयोग की गई यह विकारों को शीघ्र शान्त करती है,
english: should drink the highest measure. Hear the benefits of drinking it: properly administered, it quickly pacifies disorders,

hindi: यह मात्रा दोषों को खींच निकालने वाली, सब मार्गों में फैलने वाली, तथा शरीर, इन्द्रियों और मन को बल देने वाली और फिर से नया करने वाली है।
english: this measure draws out the doṣas, pervades all the channels, and is strengthening and renewing for body, senses and mind.
notes: The genitive śarīrendriyacetasām is taken with both balyā and punarnavakarī.
